name: Horn of Blasting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Blast
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): a 30-ft cone: DC 15 Con save or 5d6 Thunder and Deafened for 1 minute (half, not Deafened, on a success). 20% chance the horn explodes (10d6 Fire to you).

summary: Once a day, a blast in a 30-ft cone (Con DC 15, 5d6 Thunder, Deafened); each use risks the horn exploding.
text: Sounding the horn is a Magic action that unleashes a 30-foot Cone of thunder, loud enough to be heard 600 feet off. Creatures in the Cone each make a Constitution saving throw against DC 15: failing means 5d6 Thunder damage and 1 minute of the Deafened condition, while succeeding means half that damage and nothing more. Glass and crystal objects in the area that nobody is wearing or carrying take 10d6 Thunder damage. Every time you blow it, there is a 20 percent chance the horn bursts, dealing 10d6 Fire damage to you and destroying itself. After a use, the horn stays silent until the next dawn.
